# AppLock attribution

SafeNet's Android App Lock integration is based on the permission and
foreground-monitoring approach demonstrated by
[aload0/AppLock](https://github.com/aload0/AppLock).

The referenced project is licensed under the MIT License. SafeNet does not
bundle the standalone AppLock application or its Compose source; the native
implementation adapts the relevant architecture to SafeNet's existing Java
activity, local passcode recovery, selected-app storage, and Device
Administrator boundaries.
